desc: Talking with this individual feels like being constantly slapped in the face, or stabbed in the heart. Hurtful comments, mordant words, and other such verbal attacks are almost everything such a conversation consists of.
entities.name: Abrasive

desc: This Admiral is an Accomplished Sailor. Personal sailing expertise allows this leader to enhance the skills of all captains under him, [
] commanded by the Accomplished Sailor will reach their destinations more quickly.
entities.name: Accomplished Sailor

desc: Skill is the main factor that separates a master from a student. Artists carrying this particular trait will tend to evolve and hone their skills at a much faster pace than they normally would.
entities.name: Adept

desc: Planning, logistics, organization... These are all qualities possessed by this individual, allowing the smooth functioning of our government and our country as a whole. Every need and every action of our administration is accounted for, reducing bureaucratic overhead.
entities.name: Administrator

desc: This Admiral is an Aggressive Commander. Ships led by this leader will gain a bonus in combat.
entities.name: Aggressive Commander

desc: Blessed are those who share with the less favored ones. This individual takes this teaching as the most crucial, giving alms to the poor and sharing both food and coins. A group of disciples emulating these practices also follows, and thus the needs of the lower masses are attended to.
entities.name: Alms Giver

desc: Everyone has to start somewhere. Artists with this trait tend to be slow learners, taking longer to improve and sharpen their artistic skills.
entities.name: Amateur

desc: From the smallest hut to the loftiest halls, no building is too insignificant to spark this individual's architectural curiosity. In the same way as an architect designs and supervises the construction of a building, this character designs and supervises the construction of our country.
entities.name: Architect

desc: This ruler is an Architectural Visionary. Improving the infrastructure is a necessity for any state of our age and this ruler is the one who can do it. Grand visions coupled with a great understanding and talent for keeping costs down makes this ruler a great asset to us.
entities.name: Architectural Visionary

desc: An army that does not change or adapt is an army that will rust until it falls apart. This individual knows that very well, and is a great proponent of keeping the army constantly updated and adapted to newer forms of warfare.
entities.name: Army Reformer

desc: This individual feels superior to everyone, as if living in a different stratum due to divine blessing. Such a personality is difficult to satisfy, as no matter what we do, it is never enough.
entities.name: Arrogant

desc: The point of a religious life is to dedicate oneself to the faith, and not to indulge in worldly pleasures. This individual takes these teachings to heart, and refuses to partake in any delight, preferring to live with as little material sustenance as possible.
entities.name: Ascetic

desc: This ruler is considered to be a Babbling Buffoon. While our ruler means well by personally engaging in diplomacy with our neighbors this is not coupled with a talent for conducting negotiations. Anyone is likely to have a harder time seeing the points we want to make and many of our negotiations are hampered by the ineptness of our ruler.
entities.name: Babbling Buffoon

desc: This General is known as a Battlefield Medic. A larger than normal number of soldiers under this leader will be able to recover after battle to reinforce their unit back to strength.
entities.name: Battlefield Medic

desc: This ruler is Benevolent. Being seen as wanting to do good is a great asset when it comes to keeping our subjects calm.
entities.name: Benevolent

desc: This individual has lost the gift of sight.

mods.label: Can Not Lead Armies or Navies

entities.name: Blind

desc: This ruler is a Bold Fighter. Believing Shock to be of great importance on the battlefield our ruler is never fearful of the consequences and encourages everyone to lead their troops right into the midst of the enemy should the situation require it.
entities.name: Bold Fighter

desc: This General was born to the Saddle. Cavalry led by this leader will be able to make better use of their flanking advantage.
entities.name: Born to the Saddle

desc: This individual has contracted the Black Death. The terrible illness ravages their body — black swellings, raging fever, and a creeping death.
entities.name: Bubonic Plague

desc: This Admiral is a Buccaneer. Privateers commanded by this leader will be more efficient.
entities.name: Buccaneer

desc: For the vast majority of people, bureaucracy is obscure, cryptic, and incomprehensible. For others, like this individual, it comes as easy as breathing, and they are able to disentangle its mysteries with ease.
entities.name: Bureaucrat

desc: This ruler is Calm. By never losing temper or face our ruler will both inspire by example and be able to take well-thought-through decisions, allowing us to recover more quickly from any crisis the world might throw at us.
entities.name: Calm

desc: This General is a Cannoneer. Known for a great fascination with gunpowder and cannons artillery commanded by this leader will be more efficient.
entities.name: Cannoneer

desc: This ruler is Careful. By carefully navigating around the various unspoken rules in interstate relations our monarch is able to lessen the impact of our actual transgressions.
entities.name: Careful

desc: Is the reddish smudge in the royal's face an error of the careless artist or does it carry a deeper meaning of expressing the anger revolving around dealing with administrative matters? Whatever the case may be, artists with this trait will tend to fumble their art, resulting in lower quality artworks.
entities.name: Careless

desc: This explorer is a fan of maps and loves discovering uncharted lands. While the mission takes considerably more time, their documentations are of great detail. Also, their love for their work keeps this one happy enough to endure a lower payment.
entities.name: Cartographer

desc: This individual has been castrated, meaning they can no longer father children.
entities.name: Castrated

desc: This ruler is a Charismatic Negotiator. Through personal involvement in state diplomacy and negotiations our ruler is able to make others see things our way more often than would otherwise be possible.
entities.name: Charismatic Negotiator

desc: Not everyone has the skills to properly speak in public, and fewer still are those who can capture the listener's attention like this individual, able not only to change others' opinions, but also to convince them that those were originally their own.
entities.name: Charismatic Orator

desc: This child knows what they want, and it is not precisely something menial. If they could, they would take it all.
entities.name: Ambitious

desc: Despite being a child, this child is the epitome of chivalry. Brave, stylish, polite and attentive, they will surely be deserving of many poems and stories once they grow up.
entities.name: Gallant

desc: This child amazes their adult counterparts with their proven skills and future potential.
entities.name: Gifted

desc: This child enjoys being constantly surrounded of other people, and revels in the interaction with them.
entities.name: Gregarious

desc: This child is a complete idiot, and there is very little that can be done to get them a decent future.
entities.name: Idiot

desc: This child has shown to have an innate intelligence, which can be further developed.
entities.name: Intelligent

desc: The future of this child is bright, and they are predestined to leave their name into the history books.
entities.name: Prodigy

desc: This child is anything but calm and quiet, always making their presence known, and not at all in the most peaceful manner.
entities.name: Rowdy

desc: No matter where this child is or what they are doing, their mind is always working sharp as a knife. None can beat them in a contest of wits.
entities.name: Shrewd

desc: This child is not the brightest mind of their generation, and they have to make extra efforts to keep up with their counterparts.
entities.name: Slow

desc: This ruler is a conqueror. We will be able to incorporate new lands into our realm more efficiently under this regime.
entities.name: Conqueror

desc: Every time any sum of money passes through this individual's hands, it mysteriously becomes smaller. Perhaps some of these 'handling costs' should be examined...
entities.name: Corrupt

desc: This ruler is Craven. Desperately fearful of physical combat our ruler stays as far away from the battlefields as possible. Our troops cannot help but notice that they are on their own.
entities.name: Craven

desc: This ruler is seen as Cruel. Widespread tales of arbitrary and cruel actions by our ruler personally have greatly upset many of our subjects. This may not be enough to incite a rebellion in itself, but any crisis is going to hit public opinion harder as nobody lacks reasons to revolt.
entities.name: Cruel

desc: This explorer is a curious fella, not stopping exploring the area until every island has been visited; coastline has been mapped out in order to uncover the secrets of the new world. Unlike other explorers, this one does not care for personal gain.
entities.name: Curious Adventurer

desc: Almost nothing this individual says can be trusted, and those around are always doubting the intentions and watching their backs. Mistrust and paranoia ensues wherever this character goes.
entities.name: Deceitful

desc: This General is a Defensive Planner. Any troops led by this leader will be more resilient to shock.
entities.name: Defensive Planner

desc: This individual has barely survived a severe facial trauma, resulting in a terrible disfigurement.
entities.name: Disfigured

desc: The fame of this commander is known across all of East Asia leading to the nickname of a Dragon-Tiger General.
entities.name: Dragon-Tiger General

desc: This ruler is Indulgent. Always seeking relief from general apathy, our ruler indulges in great amounts of stimulants in the form of alcohol. Having an indulgent ruler reflects poorly on the entire country.
entities.name: Indulgent

desc: Scriptures and holy texts not only provide knowledge about spirituality, but also on how to govern one's everyday life. This individual excels in this kind of knowledge, to the point of being able to influence how others behave too, and administer and direct bureaucratic procedures most efficiently.
entities.name: Efficient Administrator

desc: This ruler is an Embezzler. One of the things that drive our ruler is a great will and talent to use the state revenue for increasing personal wealth.
entities.name: Embezzler

desc: This ruler is an Entrepreneur. By seeing the potential for new projects in any obstacle or opportunity our ruler contributes to an ever-growing number of projects to bolster our economy.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Market Language

entities.name: Entrepreneur

desc: This character was castrated before puberty, or was simply born that way. In courts in polygynous societies, eunuchs often fulfill specific social functions reserved for those who cannot sire heirs.
entities.name: Eunuch

desc: This ruler is an Expansionist. Our ruler is personally invested in the claiming and settlement of new lands and is dedicated to ensuring that colonial expansion remains a top priority for our state.
entities.name: Expansionist

desc: This Admiral is an Extortioner. Knowing how to best leverage an advantage of force allows our leader to do more with less and [
] commanded by the extortioner will exert greater trade power than those lead by competing captains could.
entities.name: Extortioner

desc: This individual cannot form an opinion, or is just constantly forming too many and switching between them. Whatever the case, neither firmness nor loyalty to a cause can be expected from someone like that.
entities.name: Fickle

desc: This ruler is a Fierce Negotiator. In any treaty or negotiation, our ruler will not easily cede ground and will instead continue fighting to defend our best interests.
entities.name: Fierce Negotiator

desc: Money begets money, and that is something that this individual knows very well. Through clever tactics and negotiations, our wealth is made greater than it would otherwise seem, and that in turn will bring us more wealth.
entities.name: Fiscal Hawk

desc: This ruler is a Free Thinker. Unbound by strict doctrines our ruler encourages everyone to try new things and reason freely about where to take our great country in the future.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Liturgical Language

entities.name: Free Thinker

desc: This General is a glory seeker. Troops led by this general will acquire more Prestige and Army Tradition than they otherwise would as they are always deployed where they will make the most visible difference.
entities.name: Glory Seeker

desc: This General is Goal Oriented. Troops commanded by this leader will march more quickly towards their goal.
entities.name: Goal Oriented

desc: Artists with this trait require considerably more payment as they are paramours to anything shiny and of value. Money makes the world go around and art masters who subscribe to this belief will seek as best a payment as possible.
entities.name: Gold-loving

desc: This ruler is Greedy. State revenue collection is growing increasingly iron-fisted and short-sighted under our ruler who will stop at nothing to try to increase our income. Destroying or harming every source of revenue the long-term effects of this short-sighted behavior is a great decrease of tax income.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Market Language

entities.name: Greedy

desc: This individual is fascinated by everything that lives and grows, and is constantly immersed in horticultural endeavors. From having a planter besides the desk, to laboring in a personal garden, to overseeing whole farming activities just for entertainment, it seems that no single leaf of grass in the country is beyond such caring attention.
entities.name: Green Thumb

desc: This General is known as a Hardy Warrior. Troops commanded by this leader will be more resilient to harsh conditions and suffer less [
entities.name: Hardy Warrior

desc: This individual enjoys good health and is often in high spirits.
entities.name: Healthy

desc: It is clear that constant social interaction is not the best for everyone, especially among those that want to dedicate their lives to religion. This individual is among them, preferring to live in seclusion and isolation rather than among the masses, to better commune with the divine, and without taking active interest about the matters of other people.
entities.name: Hermit

desc: This individual does not have grain of malice in the soul, and can always be trusted and taken at face value. This allows an administration under such leadership to work harmoniously, without people having to constantly worry about hidden agendas, treachery, or subterfuge.
entities.name: Honest

desc: Despite their proven skill in various arts, artists with this trait will tend to require a modest payment for their services. To them, humility is the foundation of all virtues and a cornerstone of their personalities.
entities.name: Humble

desc: This individual was born with a deformed spine, affecting their posture and appearance.
entities.name: Hunchbacked

desc: This General is a true Hussar Commander. Cavalry charges led by this character will be more effective.
entities.name: Hussar Commander

desc: Creating art is not for the feint of heart. It is a process that requires an amalgamation of some of the most important human skills, baked in with inspiration and confidence. Artist with this skill, however, are lacking in these areas and will therefore be less likely to begin working on new pieces of art.
entities.name: Idler

desc: Works created by artists with this trait tend to have a lesser impact in the world of culture and art. Truly, individuals carrying this trait are firm believers that sometimes less is more, even when it comes to prestige and cultural fame.
entities.name: Inconspicuous

desc: This ruler is Incorruptible. In many ways building a modern state is a constant battle against corruption. State officials are always tempted to take bribes, and wanting to care for one's friends and relatives is a natural human instinct. By firmly rejecting all such notion and fighting it with contempt our ruler sets an example for the entire country to follow.
entities.name: Incorruptible

desc: This ruler is Industrious. Never content to rest and through increasingly long work days our ruler is constantly managing the details of every province in the realm to maximize the output and collected revenue for all resources under state control.
entities.name: Industrious

desc: People are not made equal, and some have more power and influence than others. This individual is one with such power, whose words have the strength of laws, and whose objectives are forced to become the country's objectives.
entities.name: Influential

desc: This General is an Inspirational Leader. Troops commanded by this leader will be quicker to regain morale in the face of defeat.
entities.name: Inspirational Leader

desc: Our ruler is an Inspiring Leader. Great personal leadership can lead to even the most cowardly men finding their courage.
entities.name: Inspiring Leader

desc: This ruler is an Intricate Web-Weaver. Constantly hatching new plots our ruler is able to personally take on a great part of the responsibility for foreign intelligence.
entities.name: Intricate Webweaver

desc: ] commanded by this leader will suffer fewer damages than those commanded by other captains.
entities.name: Ironside

desc: This ruler is Just. Due to a keen understanding of the many laws and customs of his realm, our subjects trust us to rule rightfully and justly.
entities.name: Just

desc: This ruler is Kind-Hearted. A great interest in the common men and women of the realm has made our ruler well-loved and our country more resistant to harsh times in general and the ravages of war in particular.
entities.name: Kind-Hearted

desc: This ruler is a Lawgiver. Legislation is what builds up and unites a realm. Our ruler is intent on reducing the hundreds of laws and customs of the various parts of our realm to create a more centralized and just set of laws.
entities.name: Lawgiver

desc: Why complete the work today when you can complete it tomorrow? Such thoughts permeate the minds of artists with this trait, enabling them to slow down their art creation process to enjoy the finer things in life.
entities.name: Lazy

desc: This Admiral is Level-Headed. By careful drill and a cool mind crews commanded by this leader will be more resilient to morale damage from received hits during naval combat.
entities.name: Level-Headed

desc: The holy texts and ancient scriptures are the basis of religion. This individual, however, takes that feeling to the extreme, considering them the only religious basis. Not only that, but even the texts themselves are seen as invariable and infallible, where even the order of the words has a purpose.
entities.name: Literalist

desc: Often personally responsible for information breaches and leaks this ruler is generally too trusting and easily fooled. Unfortunately, the sum of this is that our ruler does more harm than good to our counterespionage efforts.
entities.name: Loose Lips

desc: This individual has suffered traumatic injuries, resulting in the loss of limb.
entities.name: Maimed

desc: This ruler is seen as Malevolent. The actions of our ruler are often seen as motivated by malice or hostile intent. As a result, any subject countries under our control are quick to anger and fear any action we take.
entities.name: Malevolent

desc: This General is one of the highly trained and specialized Mamālīk, they are originally enslaved and traded, but their aptitude for war makes them stand out to the point that their masters train them into a force of professional warriors.
entities.name: Mamlūk

desc: This ruler is a Martial Educator. Under the current regiment, the education and training of our officer corps is one of our highest priorities.
entities.name: Martial Educator

desc: This General is a Master of Arms. Infantry commanded by this leader will be more efficient and be able to deal more damage.
entities.name: Master of Arms

desc: To create art and master one's craft is no easy ordeal. Artists with this trait will often-times have impeccable organization skills and are masters of their field. As a result, the artwork created will be of elevated quality and incur more positive bonuses.
entities.name: Meticulous

desc: This ruler is Midas-Touched. The talent to make every project profitable is a great asset to the ruler of a country. Our state coffers shall never want for money as long as our ruler remains.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Market Language

entities.name: Midas Touched

desc: This General is one of the greatest theorists of all time and with the ability to use the theories in practice.
entities.name: Military Theorist

desc: To disentangle the threads of fate and be able to pierce the veil of the future is certainly not an easy feat. Many who try get consumed by madness from what they see, if they manage to see anything at all. However, for those that master clairvoyance, the future holds no secrets.
entities.name: Mystic Seer

desc: This ruler is a Naive Enthusiast. Blindly rushing ahead in trusting others and constantly underestimating the consequences, our ruler's naivety will ensure that our neighbors will take advantage of every weakness.
entities.name: Naive Enthusiast

desc: This Admiral is a Naval Engineer. [
] commanded by this leader will be able to recover more quickly from damages sustained underway or during naval engagements.
entities.name: Naval Engineer

desc: This Admiral is known as a Naval Gunner. Constant drill of gunnery crews commanded by this leader means heavy [
entities.name: Naval Gunner

desc: This Admiral is a Naval Showman. [
] commanded by this leader will receive more prestige and naval tradition from battles.
entities.name: Naval Showman

desc: This explorer has years of navigational experience and knows how to maneuver their [
entities.name: Navigator

desc: This ruler is an Obsessive Perfectionist. A keen interest in detail and minutiae is not always coupled with an equal talent for such things. Constantly causing interruptions and delays our ruler is doing a lot more harm than good when it comes to developing our internal infrastructure.
entities.name: Obsessive Perfectionist

desc: This General is an Offensive Planner. Troops commanded by this leader will gain a bonus in combat.
entities.name: Offensive Planner

desc: This individual has lost the gift of sight in one of their eyes.
entities.name: One-Eyed

desc: The mysteries of the Divine are indecipherable, except for those blessed by it. This is one of such individuals, able to commune directly with the Divine and transfer wills and petitions between this world and theirs.
entities.name: Oracle

desc: This individual is an enthusiast of the arts in all their shapes and forms. From painting to sculpture, from architecture to poetry, no art form is undeserving of admiration and promotion.
entities.name: Patron of Arts

desc: This ruler is Pious. Religiously devoted, spiritual and religious our ruler ensures that our state will not lose its course and inspire confidence in our faith.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Liturgical Language

entities.name: Pious

desc: The pox has left its mark upon this individual, with great scars and pitting covering their face — a permanent reminder of their brush with smallpox.
entities.name: Pockmarked

desc: Inspiration is the cornerstone of some of the best and most famous art pieces that defined our history. Artists with this trait will tend to fare better in terms of inspiration and thus will be more likely to commence their artwork rather frequently.
entities.name: Prescient

desc: This Admiral is a Prize Hunter. Captains commanded by this leader will be encouraged to seize more prizes and will capture more [
entities.name: Prize Hunter

desc: What better way to inscribe the legacy of our deeds than with the hiring of a prominent artist? Works created by artists with this trait will have a bigger impact in our cultural influence and growth amongst our subjects and peers.
entities.name: Prominent

desc: There may be many beliefs present in the world, but the true faith is only one. The zeal of turning lost souls into accepting the proper beliefs does not only strengthens the community but also ensures that they walk on the proper path.
entities.name: Proselytizer

desc: This character has been surrounded by eunuchs since a very young age and is greatly sympathetic towards them.
entities.name: Raised by Eunuchs

desc: This Admiral is a Ram Raider. Galleys commanded by this leader will be more efficient and deal more damage in naval battles.
entities.name: Ram Raider

desc: There are few who can be considered wells of knowledge, but those are always sought after for their teachings and instruction. Forming soon a group of loyal disciples, these great teachers are held in high reverence and respect.
entities.name: Reverend Teacher

desc: This ruler is Righteous. Our people will be less likely to question our authority as they know that a righteous ruler always has their best interest in mind.
entities.name: Righteous

desc: This General is Ruthless. Troops under the command of this leader will deal greater fire damage.
entities.name: Ruthless

desc: This Admiral is a Ruthless Blockader. Ships commanded by this leader will be able to maintain a [
entities.name: Ruthless Blockader

desc: This individual has survived a minor facial injury, resulting in a handsome scar.
entities.name: Scarred

desc: It is difficult to know what this individual is thinking at any given time, as schemes, plots, and subterfuges are always about. People have to sleep with one eye open, and always watch their backs.
entities.name: Schemer

desc: This ruler is a Scholar. The ambition to learn about the world and the governing principles of men and nature makes our ruler able to understand and implement new technology much more efficiently than would otherwise be possible.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Liturgical Language

entities.name: Scholar

desc: This explorer is a scientist first and foremost. Charting the land is less important than studying the flora and fauna of the new world.
entities.name: Scientist on Sea

desc: This ruler is Secretive. A natural instinct to keep doors closed and letters encrypted trickles down and will make our entire government harder to infiltrate for our enemies.
entities.name: Secretive

desc: This individual suffers from poor health and is often unwell.
entities.name: Sickly

desc: This General is a Siege Specialist. Sieges commanded by this leader will be conducted in a more efficient manner and should be concluded more quickly.
entities.name: Siege Specialist

desc: This ruler is considered to have a Silver Tongue. In our communication with other states, our ruler is able to present our past actions in a much more favorable light. Once our neighbors see the reasons for our actions they are much more likely to forgive us in the long run for any transgressions.
entities.name: Silver Tongue

desc: This ruler is widely regarded as a Sinner. Personal shortcomings in the leadership of our country have turned the religious establishment against us.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Liturgical Language

entities.name: Sinner

desc: This individual has contracted smallpox. Fever, vomiting, and weeping blisters cover their body — a slow and agonizing sickness.
entities.name: Smallpox

desc: The stars have fascinated the eyes of humanity since its beginnings, and many are those who seek for divine presence among them. This individual is one of them, always with the sights directed upwards in search for knowledge and answers. As there are many things that can be learned from the starts if one is willing to look.
entities.name: Stargazer

desc: This General is an unparalleled strategist and military genius. Every move on the battlefield shows brutal effectiveness, and no fort can withstand the cunning abilities of this leader.
entities.name: Strategist

desc: This ruler is Strict. Due to taking a great interest in the behavior of the troops our ruler is able to instill a strict sense of discipline in everyone in our ranks, from the lowest to the highest.
entities.name: Strict

desc: No change is small enough for this individual, all will be seen with reluctance. Set in the established ways, neither opinions nor behavior will be easily found wrong or with room for improvement, and none will be changed without difficulties.
entities.name: Stubborn

desc: This ruler is a Tactical Genius. A great personal interest and investment in battlefield maneuvers and feints will result in a much greater interest and experience in these matters for all our generals.
entities.name: Tactical Genius

desc: This individual lives among piles of coin and abacuses, always counting and writing down a precise account of all taxes and revenues. With accurate calculations, comparisons, and balances, these actions allow for the taxes to be as high as possible for what the land itself provides.
entities.name: Tax Optimizer

desc: Discussions about faith, divinity, and the Beyond are everyday occurrences around this individual, as there is no one more devout; nor is there any more arduous student of the faith and its mysteries.
entities.name: Theologian

desc: This ruler is Tolerant. Religious minorities will thrive during our regime.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Liturgical Language

entities.name: Tolerant

desc: This explorer cares only for money. They will do anything to find the rarest treasures in the new world - even if it is at the expense of the natives.
entities.name: Treasure Hunter

desc: A general with this trait has been elevated by the Senate of their country after their return from a successful campaign and given the highest honour a military officer can receive, earning both the respect and admiration of all.
entities.name: Triumphant

desc: Everybody has days in which it is hard to get any work done, but this individual takes that to the extreme. With a constant lack of any kind of motivation or drive, all work takes much longer to complete, if it is ever completed at all.
entities.name: Unmotivated

desc: Although there may be different views of certain aspects of our faith, some positions are generally more accepted than others. This individual holds some of the less common ones, causing at best disrespect from the general religious community, and marginalization at worst. However, there are also many others who share the same views, or ar at least intrigued enough to listen.
entities.name: Unorthodox

desc: A poor grasp on strategy and military tactics result in disaster any time someone like that tries to lead troops, and all close officers only hope for such incompetent general to just stand as a glorified scarecrow without blabbering foolish instructions.

mods.label: Can Not Lead Armies or Navies

entities.name: Unsuited for Army Command

desc: Leadership and governing a country is not a task everyone is fit for. Although some governments have seen their fair share of incompetent rulers, this person in particular is either not willing or not capable of being the figurehead of any respectable state.
entities.name: Unsuited for Country Ruling

desc: To be able to lead fleets, one needs a clear sense of orientation, and of course to be able to withstand the roughness of the waves. Someone incapable of that is as useless for leading a ship as an anchor, and just a complete dead weight on deck.

mods.label: Can Not Lead Armies or Navies

entities.name: Unsuited for Naval Command

desc: This ruler is Well-Advised. Always ready to listen to the wise council of others our ruler attracts a greater number of people to our court and cabinet.
entities.name: Well Advised

desc: This ruler is Well Connected. Our court and cabinet benefits from the wide network among the great minds of this era of our ruler.
entities.name: Well Connected

desc: There's truth in the saying that art masters often forget to nourish themselves or sleep properly. Such is their dedication to their craft that they will not rest or take adequate care of themselves without first finishing their next masterpiece.
entities.name: Workaholic

desc: This ruler is a Zealot. Being fanatically devoted to the true faith allows our ruler to inspire more people to convert and join the state religion.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Liturgical Language

entities.name: Zealot
